"""Standalone verification of the linkcheck anchor/HTTP-error fix (sphinx #8269).

Runs the real CheckExternalLinksBuilder against a local HTTP server, bypassing
the broken sphinxcontrib-* extensions in the venv (they require Sphinx>=5).
"""
import sys, threading, http.server, socketserver, tempfile, os
from unittest import mock

# Stub the sphinxcontrib extensions whose installed versions demand Sphinx>=5
types = __import__('types')
for name in ['sphinxcontrib.applehelp', 'sphinxcontrib.devhelp',
             'sphinxcontrib.htmlhelp', 'sphinxcontrib.jsmath',
             'sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml', 'sphinxcontrib.qthelp']:
    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
    mod.setup = lambda app=None, _n=name: {'version': '0', 'parallel_read_safe': True}
    sys.modules[name] = mod

sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/work/work/sphinx-8269-panel')

from sphinx.application import Sphinx  # noqa: E402

# --- local HTTP server -------------------------------------------------
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.do_GET()
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/ok.html'):
            body = b'<html><body id="top">hello</body></html>'
            self.send_response(200)
        else:
            body = b'<html>404 page</html>'
            self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/html')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

srv = socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
port = srv.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

# --- minimal sphinx project -------------------------------------------
src = tempfile.mkdtemp()
out = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with open(os.path.join(src, 'conf.py'), 'w') as f:
    f.write("project='p'\nmaster_doc='index'\n")
with open(os.path.join(src, 'index.rst'), 'w') as f:
    f.write(
        "ok-anchor   `a <http://127.0.0.1:%d/ok.html#top>`_\n"
        "missing-anchor `b <http://127.0.0.1:%d/ok.html#nope>`_\n"
        "http-404    `c <http://127.0.0.1:%d/gone.html#test>`_\n" % (port, port, port))

app = Sphinx(src, src, out, out, 'linkcheck', status=None, warning=None)
app.build()

content = open(os.path.join(out, 'output.txt')).read()
print('---- output.txt ----')
print(content)
print('--------------------')

ok1 = "Anchor 'nope' not found" in content          # 200 but anchor missing
ok2 = '404 Client Error' in content                  # 404 must surface, not anchor msg
ok3 = 'Anchor' not in content.split('gone.html')[1]  # 404 line has no anchor msg
ok4 = 'gone.html#test - 404' in content.replace('\n', ' ') or '404 Client Error: Not Found for url: http://127.0.0.1:%d/gone.html' % port in content
ok5 = 'ok.html#top' not in content                   # good anchor link is working
srv.shutdown()
print('RESULTS: missing-anchor-on-200=%s  http404-surfaced=%s  no-anchor-msg-on-404=%s  good-anchor-working=%s'
      % (ok1, ok2, ok3, ok5))
sys.exit(0 if (ok1 and ok2 and ok3 and ok5) else 1)
